curiosities: Falcom's Ys was first released on it in 1987.
Hideo Kojima's Snatcher first came out on it and the MSX2 in 1988.
It was one of Japan's main gaming computers in the 1980s, alongside Sharp's X1 and Fujitsu's FM-7.
Its processor is a Z80-compatible chip at 4 MHz.
Its graphics are 640 × 200 pixels in 8 colours.
The PC-8801mkII SR of 1985 added FM sound with Yamaha's YM2203.
